sections.voiceover: SAG-AFTRA and Writers Guild of America just dropped a bombshell amicus brief against OpenAI!

sections.voiceover: On Thursday, SAG-AFTRA filed a joint amicus brief against OpenAI in court. Writers Guild of America and American Federation of Music joined the legal filing. Why are 3 major Hollywood unions fighting OpenAI in this copyright battle?
b_roll: Legal paperwork showing court filing stamps.
Archival footage of guild members meeting outside.
Close up of a judge's gavel on a wooden sound block.

sections.voiceover: The joint legal filing urges a federal judge to reject fair use exemptions.
b_roll: Wide shot of federal court attorneys reviewing briefs.
Detailed view of copyright law documents.

sections.voiceover: OpenAI now faces 3 major Hollywood unions demanding the rejection of fair use. OpenAI faces this copyright battle over training models without creator permission.
